description: Decode steps of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct served by vLLM on MI355X (TP=1: 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head size 128, 16-token BF16 pages). The session ran concurrency 64 with 1024-token prompts and outputs and max_model_len 6144, so its decode batches are s64_l1024..s64_l2048; batch sizes span vLLM's decode range up to its default limit of 256 sequences and contexts reach max_model_len, plus a single 32k-token request. Contexts are ragged between half of max_seq_len and all of it. Tiny batches with short contexts are correctness-only.
